title: agalinis flava
intro: Agalinis flava, commonly known as Yellow False Foxglove, is a plant species that belongs to the Orobanchaceae family and is native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Agalinis flava include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful for soothing coughs and calming digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Agalinis flava include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
